items.text: Los Angeles Rams: QB Matthew Stafford (right elbow) a full participant - expected to start. CB Jaylen Watson (shoulder surgery) to IR, out for season. DNP - CB Trent McDuffie, S Kam Curl, TE Colby Parkinson; DE Myles Garrett (knee) limited in his IR return window. WR Davante Adams on IR.

Washington: RB Jeremy McNichols, DT Daron Payne, DT Javon Kinlaw placed on IR. DNP - WR Treylon Burks (foot), WR Stefon Diggs (rest); limited - G Sam Cosmi (knee), TE John Bates, DT Shy Tuttle. QB Jayden Daniels (left elbow) full. WR Terry McLaurin, OT Laremy Tunsil out.
